ESTABLISHMENT OF SALES TAX SERVICE RULES, 1995
ESTABLISHMENT OF SALES TAX SERVICE RULES, 1995
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 27th August,
1995]
S.R.O. 843(1)/95, dated 24‑8‑1995‑‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 25 of the Civil Servants Act, 1973
(LXXXI of 1973), the President is pleased to make the following Rules, namely:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑These Rules
may be called the Establishment of Sales Tax Service Rules, 1995.
2. Definitions.‑‑‑In these Rules, unless
there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑‑
(a) "Commission" means the Federal Public
Service Commission established under the Federal Public Service Commission
Ordinance, 1977 (XLV of 1977);
(b) "cadre post" means a post specified in the
notification issued under sub‑rule (2) rule 3;
(c) "Customs and Excise Group" means the Customs
and Excise Group constituted by the Establishment Divistion's Office Memorandum
No.5/2/75 ARC, dated the 9th May, 1975; and
(d) "Service" means the Sales Tax Service
established under rule 3 and shall deem to be a service within the meaning of
sub clause (m) of clause (viii) of rule 2 of the Occupational Groups and
Service (Promotion, Training and Seniority) Rules, 1990.
3. Establishment of Sales Tax Service.‑‑‑(1)
There shall be established a Service to be known as the Sales Tax Service.
(2) The service shall comprise such posts in the field of
sales tax as may be specified by the Federal Government by notification in the
official Gazette, from time to time;
Provided that the posts created for regular and permanent
work relating to sales tax shall, pending issuance of such notification, be
treated as temporary addition to the cadre strength.
(3) The Federal Government may remove or add any post to
the cadre strength of the Service.
4. Composition of the Service.‑‑‑(1) The
service shall consists of‑-----
(a) members of the Customs and Excise Group who opt to
become members of the Service;
Provided that such option is made within sixty days from
the commencement of these Rules;
Provided further that such option shall not vest any right
in the person making option and shall be subject to acceptance by the Federal
Government;
(b) the persons initially appointed to the posts of
Assistant Collectors of Sales Tax (Basic Pay Scale 17), Superintendents of Sales
Tax (Basic Pay Scale 16) and Senior Auditors of Sales Tax (Basic Pay Scale 16),
otherwise than through the Commission; and
(c) the persons appointed in accordance with rule 6.
(2) The option once exercised under clause (a) of sub‑rule
(1) and accepted by the competent authority shall be final.
5. Method of appointment, qualifications of cadre posts
etc.‑‑‑The method of appointment, qualifications and other
conditions of service of cadre posts shall be as laid down by the Ministry of
Finance, Government of Pakistan, in consultation with the Establishment
Division in accordance with sub rule (2) of rule 3 of the Civil Servants
(Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 1973;
Provided that for purpose of promotion to a higher cadre
post in Service, qualifying service rendered by members of Customs and Excise
Group on a post or posts in that Group shall be reckoned as service in the
Sales Tax Service under these Rules.
6. Initial appointments. ‑‑‑(l) Subject
to rules 4 and 5, all initial appointments to cadre posts in Basic Pay Scale 16
and Basic Pay Scale 18 and above reserved for initial appointment shall be made
through the Commission.
(2) Appointment to the cadre posts in the Basic Pay Scale
17 reserved for initial appointment shall be made through Annual Competitive
Examination held by the Commission.
(3) Initial appointment to cadre posts in Basic Pay Scale
15 and below reserved for initial appointment shall be made by the authorities
competent to make such appointment in accordance with the Civil Servants
(Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 1973.
